outcome.Summary: Ported reference/cron.py to Go package cron (cron/cron.go) with the exact API: Parse, (*Schedule).Next, and (*Schedule).String. It replicates all reference behaviour — field grammar (values, ranges, steps, */S, N/S, names, 7→Sunday), macros, the 5-field check, Vixie day-matching, the 5-year limit, the describe() run-length rendering, and byte-exact CronError text (including Python repr quoting). Verification: cron/cron_test.go contains hardcoded error/String/Next tests plus a golden test (cron/golden.json, 137 records generated from the Python reference) and a live cross-check against the Python CLI; I also ran two 300-case random differential comparisons (random expressions × 6 base times with offsets +00:00/-05:00/+05:30/+09:30/-08:00) against the Python reference with 0 mismatches. `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes.
